dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave spline along the trailing edge from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a low pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex curvature along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Tapered, short rostrum with moderate thickness extending from the melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon transitions to the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-resolution geometric rendering with uniform cyan-toned surface luminosity and visible tail fluke and pectoral fin silhouettes.
